items.problem: The documented data-bound NavigationView recipe could compile yet leave every later scenario stuck on the first page.
items.evidence: migration-score.json features Installed Location and Dependencies fail; final MainPage.xaml nests NavigationViewItem in MenuItemTemplate and MainPage.xaml.cs only navigates when InvokedItemContainer.DataContext is MainPageScenario.
items.wrong_text_if_any: The skill said the generated container DataContext is the bound item but omitted the content-only XAML template precondition and did not reject nested NavigationViewItem containers.
items.root_cause: NavigationView already creates containers for MenuItemsSource; nesting a second container makes the ItemInvoked data-context assumption unreliable while selection still highlights.
items.proposed_fix: Correct the anchor with a complete content-only template and add a validator failure for nested NavigationViewItem under a data-bound MenuItemTemplate.
items.generalizes: Data-bound NavigationView plus Frame is the recommended conversion for UWP SDK-sample scenario lists, so the same silent first-page-sticks failure can recur in many samples.
